entities.summary: Christian Peder Bianco Boeck was a Norwegian medical doctor, zoologist, botanist and mountaineer. He is most associated with his catalog of approved drugs, Pharmacopoea Norvegica (1854) and with his studies of trilobites. Christian Peder Bianco Boeck was a writers & intellectuals from Kongsberg (1798-09-05, Kongsberg–1877-07-11).
